mobileSdk.scope: Published preview sources plus local mobile build/transport/packaging changes. Native module sources and host decoder sources are included in each ZIP; unrelated frontend working-tree changes were excluded.

mobileSdkSizes.scope: Complete offline source SDK ZIPs smaller than 3 MiB. Run the included node prepare-runtime.mjs on the developer computer before integration; all asset data and C++ decoder sources are included. Strong decompression never runs on the phone. runtimeBytes measures the distribution payload, preparedRuntimeBytes the app-ready Brotli assets, decodedRuntimeBytes their decoded contents. Native apps retain streamed reads, lazy modules and all offline formats. Not precompiled AAR/XCFramework artifacts. Excludes external build tools and filesystem allocation overhead.
